asr.full_text: This is Shah, and Doge is once again showing a very clean and structured move, but at the same time it is testing your patience, because when a market respects levels again and again, most traders start overthinking instead of trusting the setup. Right now price is trading around 0.093$, and it has just revisited the marked support around 0.090$, and held it perfectly once again. So let me ask you this, when price comes back to the same support around 0.090 and held it perfectly once again so let me ask you this when price comes back to the same support multiple times and refuses to break? Do you assume it is getting weak or do you recognize that repeated holds actually build strength for a continuation move? What we are seeing here is a very clear reaction price tap to support, buyers stepped in immediately and the market pushed back up towards the first target around 0.095 . The important detail here is that price is not getting strongly rejected from that level, which tells us that selling pressure is not dominant and buyers are still in control. Now this is where structure becomes very important. Dooge is consistently forming higher highs and higher lows and that is the simplest definition of an uptrend there is no messy price action no random spikes just clean movement respecting levels and moving step by step higher but here is the mistake most traders make when price does not explode immediately they think the move is over in reality strong, strong trends often move slowly, build structure and then expand. This slow movement is actually a sign of strength because it shows controlled buying rather than emotional pumps. As long as Doge continues to hold above the 0.090 support on a daily closing basis, there is no reason to shift bearish. That level is acting as a strong foundation. And every successful retest adds more confidence to the bullish structure. Now, looking ahead, the next step is very clear. If price continues this structure and breaks above the mini resistance around 0.095 with strength, then the path opens towards the main resistance at 0.10. This level is very important because it is both a psychological barrier and a technical resistance where we can expect some reaction. If momentum is strong and buyers continue to step in a clean break above 0.10 can lead to further upside expansion. But again, the key is confirmation, not assumption. On the other hand, if price fails to break higher and starts losing momentum, then we may see another pull back towards the 0.0090 support. And if that level eventually breaks with strong daily closes below it, then the structure weakens and we can expect a deeper correction phase. So right now, the entire setup is very simple and very clean. Hold the support, follow the trend and look for continuation lose the support and prepare for a pullback this is a market where structure is doing all the talking and if you stay patient and follow the levels the moved be very easy to understand join Shah comm for free signals and let me know which coin you want me to cover next
